# 上海树下小屋网络科技有限公司 (TreeHouse Tech / Shanghai Shuxia Xiaowu Network Technology Co., Ltd.)

> Independent app studio behind three privacy-first, local-first mobile apps. Data stays on the user's device by default; cloud sync (where offered) is optional and uses the user's own private cloud. Website: https://sxxw.site · Support email: house@sxxw.site · Languages: 60+ (Simplified/Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, and more; per-language pages under /<lang>/).

Core principles across all apps: user control, local-first processing, minimal data collection, no third-party ad/tracking SDKs.

## Apps

- [足迹·TimeTrails](https://sxxw.site/apps/timetrails/): Privacy-first GPS trail recorder. Automatically records walking, running, cycling, driving and travel routes; shows your footprints on a map and "lights up" the cities you've visited; daily trails, trip stats, a 3D trail globe and a fog-of-war explore map. Platforms: iPhone / iPad / Apple Watch. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6752662508 . Data is stored on-device by default; iCloud private backup/sync is optional.
- [纪念日·倒数 (Memoria)](https://sxxw.site/apps/memoria/): Countdown and reminder app for birthdays, anniversaries and important days, with home-screen widgets and on-the-day reminders. iOS version (App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760106574) is local-first with optional iCloud sync; HarmonyOS version (Huawei AppGallery: https://appgallery.huawei.com/app/C6917613545100329502) is fully local — no network, no sync.
- [出行轨迹 TraceApp](https://sxxw.site/apps/traceapp/): Local-first trip/route tracker showing path, mileage and pace. Platform: iPhone. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1634761411 . TraceApp users can migrate their data to the newer 足迹·TimeTrails — guide: https://sxxw.site/migrate/ .

## Facts

- Company (Chinese): 上海树下小屋网络科技有限公司
- Website: https://sxxw.site
- Support email: house@sxxw.site
- App privacy stance: local-first; no third-party advertising or tracking SDKs; optional cloud uses the user's own account (Apple iCloud private database).
- Multilingual: each page is available per language at https://sxxw.site/<lang>/... with hreflang alternates (Simplified Chinese at the root).
